content: YAML frontmatter traps: unquoted 2026-08-12 becomes a Date object via js-yaml and gray-matter; YAML 1.1 parsers read no, yes, off as booleans (Norway problem); 0123 becomes 123; CRLF breaks regex-based frontmatter splitters (Copilot CLI 694, qwen-code 2053, neo 8787); a UTF-8 BOM also breaks them. Fix: normalise CRLF and strip BOM before parsing, treat dates and ids as strings via schema, quote on write.
